subject: Role pruning playbook & SOC 2 evidence — SCIM/SAML samples
messages:
From: Katie Rivers <katie.rivers@cedarhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cedar Health Security <security@cedarhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: role pruning playbook + supporting artifacts for SOC 2 audit

Hi Sean —

We're lining up our SOC 2 audit evidence and need to confirm Redwood's approach for role pruning and least-privilege enforcement. Can you provide a compact playbook and the following artifacts we usually collect for customers?

- Role-pruning/playbook document that explains remediation steps and owner responsibilities
- A recent SCIM delta export (anonymized) showing user/role changes over a 30-day window
- Sample SAML assertions for both user and service-account flows (suitable for spot-checking)
- Owner matrix (who owns roles, service accounts, and escalation contacts)
- Estimated timeline for remediation work and evidence delivery for SOC 2 acceptance

We appreciate redacted samples if necessary. Goal is to have initial artifacts by Oct 12 so our auditor can include them in the control set.

Thanks —
Katie Rivers
Security Programs Manager, Cedar Health
Katie.Rivers@cedarhealth.com

Hi Katie —

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Looping in Laura (security PM) and Vanessa (IAM ops) to pull the artifacts and produce a short playbook geared to auditor consumption.

Planned next steps:
1) Vanessa to pull a 30-day anonymized SCIM delta and provide a short readme explaining redactions.
2) Vanessa to export a couple of SAML assertion examples (user sign-in, service account) with identifying fields redacted.
3) Laura to assemble a concise role-pruning playbook (3–4 pages) with remediation runbooks and owner responsibilities.
4) I will consolidate the owner matrix and draft a workback timeline for Cedar Health's auditor.

Can we target Oct 6 for an internal handoff and Oct 12 for the delivery you requested? If that works, I'll schedule a 30-min alignment call with your auditor.

Sean Gallagher

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: role pruning playbook + supporting artifacts for SOC 2 audit

Morning — delivering the first-pass artifacts to the shared drive now:

Files uploaded to https://drive.redwood.com/shared/cedar-health/role-pruning/:
- scim-delta-sample.csv (30-day export; columns: timestamp, user_id(redacted), action, prev_roles, new_roles)
- saml-assertion-examples.txt (2 examples: user_login + service_account_token; subject/email/redacted)
- owner-matrix.xlsx (role -> owner email, team, oncall)
- owner-matrix-readme.txt (how owners were mapped and redaction notes)

Quick notes:
- SCIM delta is anonymized (user_id replaced with u-xxxx) and trimmed to show role churn only.
- Service accounts are tagged in the export with "svc-" prefix so auditors can filter.
- We'll include a signed CSV hash (SHA256) in the final package to show export integrity.

Estimated remediation workback (high level):
- Week 1 (Oct 11–15): Triage top 20 service accounts flagged for excessive roles
- Week 2 (Oct 18–22): Role owners confirm minimal privilege mappings; create PRs for role changes
- Week 3 (Oct 25–29): Deploy changes behind feature flag; smoke test and collect evidence

I've attached the artifact stubs below for your reference.

Vanessa Ortiz
IAM Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Hi Katie —

Thanks for your patience. Per our plan, we've placed an initial SOC 2–friendly evidence bundle in the shared folder here: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/cedar-health/role-pruning/

Contents delivered (initial):
- role-pruning-playbook.pdf (3 pages): scope, decision tree, remediation runbook, rollback guidance
- owner-matrix.xlsx: role owners and escalation contacts
- scim-delta-sample.csv: anonymized 30-day SCIM export (readme included)
- saml-assertion-examples.txt: redacted assertion samples and fields mapping
- workback-timeline-v2.xlsx: proposed 3-week remediation schedule with owners and evidence collection checkpoints
- integrity.txt: SHA256 digests for CSV/TXT files

Next steps we propose:
1) Kickoff workshop with your auditor (30 min) — to walk them through artifacts and redaction approach
2) Begin remediation triage per the workback (Vanessa -> role owner outreach)
3) Deliver final signed evidence bundle (with CSV hash and PR links) by Oct 29 for auditor consumption

If you'd like a DocuSign chain-of-custody for the bundle, we can arrange that as an add-on; otherwise the integrity hashes and signed readme are normally sufficient for SOC reviewers.

Would you like us to schedule the auditor walk-through next week?

Best,
Sean Gallagher
